summary: Implemented and verified phases 6-8 of the 13-phase input-scoped gate invalidation plan (phases 1-5 landed in prior dispatches). Phase 6 replaced test-lint-shellcheck-parallel.sh's ~120s real-corpus acceptance pair with a fast, deterministic fixture-based dispatch-shape proof (~2s, via a PATH-substituted stub shellcheck) and closed the suite's hint-coverage gap; it also found and fixed an unrelated latent bug where test-check-record-versioning.sh had never had its executable bit set, so run-all.sh had silently skipped (never executed) it since it was added. Phase 7 made --skip-unchanged structurally unreachable from deploy_findings_snapshot -- the single shared function behind all six pre/post findings-baseline comparisons in the codebase -- closing the dispatch's own named sharpest correctness hazard, and proved all three fail-open classes (unreadable store, sentinel key, format_version mismatch) at the real verify-deploy.sh interface. Phase 8 measured both verify-deploy-testing suites' nested-invocation costs on an idle host, then applied the measured-appropriate remedy to each: narrowed test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh's one full-battery baseline to --max-cost moderate (159.2s -> 25.2s, an 84% cut, identical PASS/FAIL outcome), and split test-verify-deploy-gate-selection.sh's non-narrowable 23-gate crash net (82% of that suite's cost) into its own new suite for scheduling. All three phases committed separately and verified green; 0 shellcheck findings across every touched/created file. Five phases remain (9-13), covering per-gate equivalence proof, JOBS_CAP re-derivation, two evidence-gated derived phases, and the final redeploy/measurement that closes the task.

artifacts.summary: Phases 1-8 of 13: the core invalidation feature (phases 1-5) plus this round's gate-set efficiency work -- fixture-based shellcheck acceptance (Phase 6), attestation integrity (Phase 7), and narrowing/splitting the two verify-deploy-testing stragglers (Phase 8).
Concrete resume point for Phase 9 (flagged as plausibly a multi-dispatch phase on its own), plus key decisions and what-not-to-try guidance from phases 6-8.
